recommendations.description: Add comprehensive edge case tests for search functionality: empty strings, special regex characters, null inputs, and case sensitivity variations. Current coverage at 65% is too low for production.
Implement memoization for regex compilation and debouncing for search input to prevent performance degradation with large todo lists. Consider useMemo() in React components.
Add validation for search term: check for empty/null strings and escape special regex characters. Missing validation could cause unexpected behavior or regex errors.
Extract regex compilation and matching logic into separate, testable functions. This will improve code clarity and test coverage.
